title: CrossFit Strength Haven

services.name: CrossFit + Nutrition
services.desc: CrossFit is designed to be constantly varied, meaning everyday is different so you never get bored. All workouts are based on the core movements of life, and these movements reflect the best aspects of gymnastics, weightlifting, conditioning and more. All of our CrossFit Classes are coach-led and follow a planned progression roughly 60 minutes in duration. No matter if you’re new to CrossFit or have been doing this for years all the workouts can be adjusted in weight, intensity, and certain mechanics to scale to the experience and fitness levels of any individual.
